title: FLIR1 video leaked on a German server before 2017
summary: Jesse Michels tells of FLIR1 video leaked on a German server before 2017, about 2007-2017 at Germany (online server), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Reddit and it was even on a German server.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that FLIR1, a military infrared camera video of an unexplained object, was already floating around online before 2017, posted on Reddit, a large discussion website, and even on a German server. He tells it because, if true, it would mean the footage was out in public well before it got wide attention.
